body:
Dear friend,

The wind's turning cold on the high pasture, and it's time to bring the flock down for the autumn.

Will you walk up the mountain road and help me? The lambs you met in spring are nearly grown!
summary: Help Mr. Silas pen the flock.

tasks.where: on the mountain (walk the mountain road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
